Pluto.Address_comment: IP address of the Pluto (USB network: 192.168.2.1)
Pluto.ServerPort_comment: TCP port of FW/ptx_server on the Pluto
Pluto.TxLO_MHz_comment: carrier, MHz (AD9363 data sheet 325 to 3800; most Plutos tune 70 to 6000)
Pluto.TxGain_dB_comment: Tx attenuation as a gain, -89.75 to 0 dB
Pluto.RfBandwidth_MHz_comment: analog RF bandwidth, MHz (the signal occupies 16.4 MHz)
Pluto.Gap_comment: idle samples after every packet (rounded up to 16, at most 1048560)
Pluto.FileRepeat_comment: times the file is sent; 0 = until Stop
Pluto.Loopback_comment: 1: one random packet looped TX1 -> RX1 on the same Pluto and decoded
Pluto.RxGain_dB_comment: loopback only: manual Rx gain, dB
Pluto.CaptureSamples_comment: loopback only: samples captured at 40 Msps
